Lecture Overview:
Are multi-agent systems better than a single AI agent? Often not. In this Stanford CS329Z: Engineering AI Agents lecture, Michael Ryan explains when to use one agent vs. many, orchestration patterns (orchestrator-worker, swarm, hybrid), how agents communicate through handoffs, message boards, and Google's Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol, coordination tools like task ledgers, shared memory, and git worktrees, and the research on why multi-agent systems fail.
Speaker: Michael Ryan
